v2.caption: connector seated: it lies flat, fully inside the green pocket. Answer A yes, B yes.
connector NOT seated: it is not down in the pocket. Answer A no, B no.
fork seated: the orange wire runs through the gap between the two prongs, below the yellow knobs. Answer A yes, B yes.
fork NOT seated: the gap between the prongs is empty; the wire lies on the board next to the fork. Answer A no, B no.
